person:gandalf.note: As Olórin he dwelt in the gardens of Irmo, long before he was sent east.
As Olórin he often went to Nienna and learned pity and patience from her.

person:finwe.note: Ruled the Noldor as their first king from the white city of Tirion.
Slain by Melkor at the doors of Formenos while his son Fëanor was away.

person:feanor.note: Lived in Tirion before his exile and led the Noldor out of it after the Oath.
Summoned before the Valar at the Ring of Doom and sentenced to exile for drawing his sword.
Lived here in exile with his sons and kept the Silmarils in its treasury.
Led the Noldor in the Kinslaying and seized the Teleri ships.

person:fingolfin.note: Lived in Tirion until he led his host out after Fëanor.
Led his people across the Grinding Ice to reach Middle-earth.

person:finarfin.note: Turned back with his people after the Doom of Mandos was spoken.
Ruled the Noldor who remained in Aman after the host left.

person:ungoliant.note: Lived in a dark ravine here before Melkor found her.
Climbed Hyarmentir with Melkor to look upon Valinor.
Poisoned the Two Trees at Ezellohar with Melkor, who struck them with his spear.
Drank the wells of Varda dry after the Trees were slain.
Crossed the Grinding Ice with Melkor into Middle-earth.

person:morgoth.note: Held prisoner in the Halls of Mandos for three ages after his capture.
Came to Avathar and made his bargain with Ungoliant.
Climbed Hyarmentir with Ungoliant to look on Valinor.
Slew the Two Trees at Ezellohar with Ungoliant.
Slew Finwë at Formenos and stole the Silmarils from its treasury.
Crossed the Grinding Ice with Ungoliant when he fled from Valinor.

person:luthien.note: Sang before Mandos in his halls after Beren died, and won his pity.

person:beren.note: Waited in the Halls of Mandos after death until Lúthien won his release.

person:earendil.note: Passed the Enchanted Isles and the Shadowy Seas on his voyage to Valinor.
Climbed Túna and found Tirion empty, for the Elves were away at a festival.
Came before the Valar in Valmar and pleaded for the Elves and Men.

person:melian.note: Dwelt in the gardens of Irmo before she went to Middle-earth.

person:manwe.note: Sits with Varda in Ilmarin on the summit of Taniquetil as King of the Valar.
Sat in council with the Valar at the Ring of Doom.

person:varda.note: Dwells with Manwë in the halls of Ilmarin on Taniquetil.
Kept the dew of Telperion and the light of Laurelin in great vats.

person:ulmo.note: Dwells in the Outer Sea, outside the lands of Valinor.
Ferried the Eldar over the sea on the island; at his bidding Ossë rooted it in the Bay of Eldamar.

person:aule.note: Dwells and works in his mansions in Valinor; the books give no exact place.

person:yavanna.note: Sang the Two Trees into life on the green mound of Ezellohar.
Her pastures lie in the south of Valinor.

person:orome.note: Keeps his great forests in Valinor, where he hunts before riding out to Middle-earth.

person:mandos.note: Keeps the Halls of Awaiting where the Elves slain in the world wait.
His Doom was spoken to the Noldor on the shores of Araman.

person:nienna.note: Her halls lie in the far west of Valinor, near the Halls of Mandos.

person:lorien.note: Lives in his gardens, the fairest place in the world, with his wife Estë.

person:este.note: Lives in the gardens of Lórien with her husband Irmo.
Sleeps by day on a tree-grown island in the lake Lórellin.

person:vaire.note: Weaves her tapestries of time in the Halls of Mandos.

person:osse.note: Taught the Teleri the arts of the sea while they lived on the island.

person:ar-pharazon.note: After his landing in Aman, hills fell on him and his warriors; they lie there (later time).

thing:silmarils.note: Stolen by Melkor from the treasury of Formenos when he slew Finwë.

thing:swan-ships.note: Built by the Teleri; Fëanor's host seized them here in the Kinslaying.

thing:two-trees.note: Grew on Ezellohar for ages and gave Valinor its light; Melkor and Ungoliant poisoned them there.

thing:elostirion-stone.note: It looked west to the tower of Avallónë on Tol Eressëa, where the Master-stone stood (Unfinished Tales).

person:fingon.note: Led the vanguard of Fingolfin's host into the fight at Alqualondë without knowing its cause.
Crossed the Grinding Ice with his father's host.

person:turgon.note: Crossed the Grinding Ice with Fingolfin; his wife Elenwë was lost there.

person:galadriel.note: Crossed the Grinding Ice with the host of Fingolfin.

thing:vingilot.note: Eärendil anchored the ship in the Bay of Eldamar before he went ashore.
